dossier.scp_unleashed.106.title: The Old Man
dossier.scp_unleashed.106.caption: SCP-106 in a lower-level corridor, moments after rising through the floor.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-106 is to be held in a sealed cell lined on every side, floor and ceiling included. %rOrdinary masonry has never held it.%r
**No member of staff is to enter the cell.** All cell doors are to stay shut.
In the event of a breach, personnel are to leave the area and wait for the recontainment team. Recontainment calls for a living lure. %rProcedure 106-Femur is on file.%r

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-106 is a humanoid figure a little over two metres tall, of extremely gaunt build. Its skin is dark, wet-looking and corroded throughout. It wears the rotted remains of an old military uniform and helmet, eaten through like its skin. Its fingers are long and thin, and it wears a fixed, wide grin. It moves slowly, breathes loudly and often laughs to itself.
SCP-106 passes through solid matter as if it were not there, leaving a dark residue behind. It hunts people: staff, D-Class and civilians alike. %rIt is never in a hurry.%r
Those it touches sink into a place of its own. Few have come back.
SCP-106 does not always walk to its prey. It has been seen to sink into the ground and return somewhere close by, through a floor, a wall or a ceiling.
Conventional termination has been attempted several times. Each attempt was logged as a success. Each was followed by a new sighting.

page.title: Addendum 106-1: Appearance
page.text: SCP-106 has no recovery site. It was first seen on the night after a reader finished this file, rising out of the ground nearby. %rReading this file in daylight does not help.%r

page.title: Addendum 106-2: Recovered Testimony
text: A D-Class subject returned after six days missing. He described stone corridors without end and doorways full of darkness. %rMost of them, he said, led back.%r
He does not remember how he left.

block.scp_unleashed.scp106_femur_breaker: A reinforced restraint chair beneath a heavy drop arm.
Takes up 2x2 blocks: the lever tower stands to the right of the chair, seen from the front
Right-click the chair to sit; right-click it with a lead to strap in someone you are leading
Someone else pulls the lever on the tower; right-click an occupied chair to unbuckle it

message.scp_unleashed.scp106.breach_warn: A low hiss rises from the containment cell.
message.scp_unleashed.scp106.restrained: The restraints lock around you. Press sneak again and again to struggle free.
message.scp_unleashed.scp106.no_leashed: Nobody on your lead to strap in.
message.scp_unleashed.scp106.lever_reach: You can't reach the lever from the chair.
message.scp_unleashed.scp106.struggled_f: You wrench free of the restraints.
SCP-106, "The Old Man": a tall, gaunt, corroded humanoid. Keter-class. It breathes heavily and laughs to itself.
It walks through walls, floors and ceilings as if they were not there, leaving a dark residue behind. Its touch drags people into a place of its own.
It hunts people: players, D-Class and villagers. It never hurries. When its prey runs too far, it sinks away and is suddenly close again.
It has %s health, shrugs off most harm and mends quickly. No attempt to put it down has ever held for long. It does not occur naturally; reading its file is enough to draw it out.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp106_femur_brea: Recontainment equipment: a restraint chair beneath a heavy drop arm. Someone sits in the chair, and another person pulls the lever.
The arm comes down hard. What happens next depends on what is listening.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp106_doorway.1: A doorway of pure darkness, found in only one place. Where it leads changes every time.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp106_pocket_sto: Dark, corroded stone from a place that should not exist. Where it was found, nothing can break it.

archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp106.0: There is no site to visit. It comes to the reader.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp106.1: Expect it after dark, the first night after reading.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp106.2: Walls will not keep it out.
